title: OrderCheck
description: A check on an order, holding guests, payments, and surcharges.

gratuityAmount.description: Applied auto-gratuity amount, as a decimal string.

totalAmount.description: Final check total, as a decimal string.

paymentsAmount.description: Total payments received, as a decimal string.

balanceAmount.description: Remaining balance, as a decimal string.

items.description: A guest on an order check.
A surcharge applied to an order check or payment.

surchargeName.description: Surcharge name at the time of application.

createdAt.description: RFC 3339 timestamp when the surcharge was applied.

amount.description: Surcharge amount in US dollars, as a decimal string.

taxesAmount.description: Applied tax amount, as a decimal string.

items.description: A payment recorded against an order check.

paymentName.description: Payment method name at the time of application.

createdAt.description: RFC 3339 timestamp when the payment was applied.

amount.description: Payment amount in US dollars, as a decimal string.

tipAmount.description: Tip amount in US dollars, as a decimal string.

tipDeductionAmount.description: Processing fee deduction from the tip, as a decimal string.

tipAppliedToEmployeeId.description: Identifier of the employee the tip was applied to.

employeeId.description: Identifier of the employee who processed the payment.

employeeName.description: Name of the employee who processed the payment.

cardType.description: The card type used for the payment.

cardNumber.description: Last four digits of the card, formatted as "...XXXX".

items.description: A tax applied to an order line, modifier, or surcharge.

taxId.description: Tax identifier. Empty for splick.it orders.

taxName.description: Tax name at the time of application.

percentage.description: Tax percentage as a decimal string, for example "6.5".

amount.description: Tax amount in US dollars, as a decimal string.

items.description: Items applied directly to the check, typically empty.
A menu item line on an order check or guest.

name.description: Item name at the time the order was placed.

createdAt.description: RFC 3339 timestamp when the item was added.

quantity.description: Decimal quantity as a string. Subitems show the parent quantity.

preDiscountsAmount.description: Extended amount before discounts and taxes, as a decimal string.

discountsAmount.description: Total applied discounts, as a decimal string.

postDiscountsAmount.description: Amount after discounts and before taxes, as a decimal string.

taxesAmount.description: Applied taxes, as a decimal string.

totalAmount.description: Final amount after discounts and taxes, as a decimal string.

giftCardIssueReload.description: Whether the line represents a gift card sale or reload.

voidedItems.description: Voided items applied directly to the check.
